item.title: McKenzie Mayor Ryan Griffin announces bid for reelection
item.description: Mayor of McKenzie, Ryan Griffin, has announced his bid for reelection.

item.title: Our Jackson Home releases open calls for temporary mural projects for West TN artists
item.description: Our Jackson Home, in collaboration with the City of Jackson, has released two open calls for a new sidewalk art installation near the Carnegie Center for Arts and History and two new temporary alleyway murals off of Liberty Street in Downtown Jackson.

item.title: Robert Duvall, Oscar-winning actor and ‘Godfather’ mainstay, dead at 95
item.description: Robert Duvall, the Oscar-winning actor of matchless versatility and dedication whose classic roles included the intrepid consigliere of the first two "Godfather" movies and the over-the-hill country music singer in "Tender Mercies," has died at age 95.

item.title: Former Carroll County fire chief Terry Bradshaw dies at 70
item.description: Former Carroll County Fire Chief Terry Dean Bradshaw, 70, has died.

item.title: 2 found dead in Milan after officials respond to house fire, TBI investigating
item.description: Two people were found dead on West Cherry Street in Milan earlier Monday, authorities confirmed.

item.title: Crockett County teen auditions for American Idol
item.description: A Crockett County teen got the chance to audition for one of the country's biggest talent shows.

item.title: National Weather Service offers storm spotter classes in West Tennessee
item.description: The National Weather Service in Memphis is offering classes to train storm spotters ahead of severe weather season.

item.title: Better Business Bureau warns of child identity theft scams
item.description: The Better Business Bureau is warning families about identity theft scams targeting children.

item.title: Bethel University announces strategic leadership appointments to advance mission and growth
item.description: Bethel University is pleased to announce three strategic leadership appointments that will further strengthen the University’s mission and distinctive extracurricular experiences.

item.title: Warm & Humid Mid Week, Late Week Rain & Storm Chances Back!
item.description: WBBJ 7 Forecast Update: After a soggy Valentine’s Weekend across West Tennessee, we started out dry to kick off the work week. Many people saw over 2″ of well needed rain that definitely helped out with the drought situation we are currently in.
